verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI model training is a fair privacy question for a web-data API SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, data-usage policy, or retention control. The only opt-out mention is a community quote about websites asking to be added to a scraping block list, which is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
